title: Luke Skywalker with Grogu in Tow
description: As it happens in most every life, the student becomes the master. When Luke Skywalker trained to become a Jedi Knight in the dark swamps of Dagobah, he carried his master, Yoda, on his back. Yoda offered insight, wisdom and training from within the very same pack that Luke Skywalker now carries Grogu in. Together, Luke and Grogu leap through the jungles of a distant planet and train in the mysterious ways of the Force, this time with Luke dispensing the wisdom instead of receiving it. Grogu takes everything in, an eager student, gaining new mastery of the Force every day.
